Shilika Jain writes and edits whitepapers for Web3 and AI founders, with finished documents placing projects in CoinDesk, Forbes and Decrypt within weeks of publication. mainEntity.name: What is a crypto whitepaper writing service and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: A crypto whitepaper writing service takes your protocol's technical and economic design and turns it into a structured document that investors, listing teams, journalists and community members can evaluate. It is for founders who have a working product or a clear protocol design but lack the writing resource to produce a document that reads clearly under due diligence. Shilika Jain runs this as a focused sprint for Web3 and AI founders, covering everything from the abstract to the tokenomics appendix.

mainEntity.name: How much does a crypto whitepaper cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full draft-to-final whitepaper sprint with Shilika Jain runs $5K–$12K depending on protocol complexity, the number of revision rounds required and whether a paired press release and media summary are included. This is comparable to what a content agency charges for the same scope, with the difference that a senior operator with direct Web3 media relationships writes the document rather than a generalist contractor.

mainEntity.name: What does the finished whitepaper include?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard deliverable covers: executive abstract, problem framing, solution architecture, technical differentiation, tokenomics and economic model, team and advisors, roadmap, and a references section. The handoff includes Google Docs and PDF-ready files plus a one-page media summary and three headline options for the press release, so you can move straight to outreach without a separate briefing round.

mainEntity.name: How long does the whitepaper writing process take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical timeline from signed brief to first draft is 10 to 14 working days. The revision round adds 3 to 5 days depending on the volume of founder feedback. Total sprint from kick-off to final handoff is usually 3 to 4 weeks. If you have a hard deadline, share it at the briefing stage and the schedule is built backwards from that date.

mainEntity.name: How do I get started with a crypto whitepaper?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send a short project brief through the intent form with a one-paragraph summary of your protocol, your target audience and your timeline. You will get a reply within 24 hours with a read on scope and next steps, or book a 30-minute call and we will map it live. No lengthy intake form, no agency-style kickoff deck.
